name: FemalePatientBirths
title: Female Patient Births
description: An SQLQuery that joins the active-female-patients-view SQLView with the patient_multiple_birth ViewDefinition, returning id, gender, and multiple_birth for each female patient.

extension.valueString: SELECT female_patients.id, female_patients.gender, births.multiple_birth FROM female_patients JOIN births ON female_patients.id = births.id
